Name: Custom Mounts
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod provides a framework for creating custom mounts that spawn from custom stables.

For users, just install this mod like any other mod, it will allow mods that create custom mounts to work.



[size=5][b]Creating Custom Mounts[/b][/size]

To start, you will need a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Buildings]custom building[/url] with the "BuildingType" set to "StardewValley.Buildings.Stable".

Then, you can create a custom mount to associate with that building, using Content Patcher, targetting the dictionary at "aedenthorn.CustomMounts/dict".

This associates Pinkie the big, pink horse with the Pinkie House building. When a Pinkie House is built, a Pinkie will appear next to it.


[b][size=5]Explanation[/size][/b]

[b]Stable[/b] in the custom mount data should be the dictionary key from [b]Data/Buildings[/b] for the mount's stable.
[b]
SpawnOffset[/b] is the tile offset from the top left tile of the stable on which to spawn the mount (default is 1,1).

[b]Speed[/b] has to be an integer (vanilla is 2).
[b]
[b]EatSpeed[/b]Bonus[/b] is the speed boost gained by feeding the mount its special food (vanilla is 0.4).[b]

FrameWidth[/b] and [b]FrameHeight[/b] are in pixels, vanilla is 32.
[b]
[/b][b]HatOffsets[/b] and [b]HatScale[/b] are for mounts with different proportions than the default horse (can omit).

[b]FluteItem[/b] and [b]FluteSound[/b] allow for custom summon flute items (can omit).

[b]EatItem[/b] and [b]EatSound[/b] allow for custom "carrot" items (can omit).


[b][size=5]CustomAnimations[/size][/b]

The [b]CustomAnimations[/b] field allows you to override the random grass eating animation, and optionally have sound play at certain frames.

[b]Chance [/b]should be between 0 and 1 (=100%). 

You can have multiple possible animations for each facing direction (0 = up, 1 = right, etc.), but each animation should be named differently (Right1, Right2, etc.).


[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]

There is an example content pack in the Optional FIles section.

By default, a single player can own multiple stables and mounts of different kinds. The vanilla game doesn't allow this, and I don't know why that is but if you are afraid of potential consequences, you can disable multiple mount ownership in the config. You will still be able to have multiple mounts of different kinds, but only one will belong to you (affects calling them using the flute, at the least).

The mod also allows you to rename mounts by interacting while holding down a mod key (default [b]LeftAlt[/b]). You can change the key in the config.


Source code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/[/url]

Pinkie responds to the ancient drum, and is partial to ice cream.
